execution.claims: atomic and exclusive (claim_exclusive in .beads/config.yaml) through `br update <id> --claim --actor '<harness>-<role>:<person>@<machine>:<branch>#<session>'`; the holder is the agent doing the work, never the person
execution.mutationFallback: no mutation tool: at stage acceptance the coordinator hand-plants 2-3 mutations in the changed logic and records whether a test went red; a survivor becomes a test or a question to the owner, never a pass
execution.reviewer: openai-codex/gpt-6-sol (a codex worker session), one round, at stage acceptance
execution.reviewFallback: same-model independent session (a fresh zai/glm-5.3 session), disclosed as the same model
